wing_skin_per_sub_cell_1D.reading: the outer two sub-cells sit within 1 mm of the skin on every wrist: SIM-13 case; mitigation: active wing only to s about 8-10 mm, or a light outer zone (alpha <= 0.3)

winter_capsule_physics_lens.cell limits (Markyn 201021 p.4): charge 0-45 C, < 0 C prohibited; discharge -10 to 60 C
winter_capsule_physics_lens.consequence: the 0 C PV inhibit (ARCH 4.4 rule 5) stops PV charging in cold outdoor time; with the MCU off nothing stops the BQ25570 charging a sub-zero cell (O-2)

rf.note: E (fix stage, physics P-7): every tail is tied to the board ground at the entry, so it acts as a monopole on the pod ground and resonates first at a QUARTER wave (30.7 mm in air at 2.44 GHz): the 14 mm tails at eps_eff about 4.8, the USB feed, the wing string and the cell foil already near eps_eff 1. SIM-10/11 must model each tail with its GND conductor. One 0402 RF link per conductor, GND included, is reserved at the entry lands (FB1-FB7 in V3-R); a common-mode choke if SIM-10/11 asks; SIM-08 checks the ESD return
